fieldMapping.note: Linear issue identifier, used to fetch comments
Issue title included in digest message
All comments collected via cursor pagination, concatenated into a single string

assumptions: The Linear webhook payload includes the issue ID and title when the issue is closed.
The Discord integration uses a bot token or webhook URL to post messages to a specific channel.
Cursor pagination in Linear returns comments in pages with a 'cursor' field for the next page.
The final digest message will be a concatenation of all comment bodies retrieved from the issue.

example.query: query GetComments($issueId: String!, $after: String) { issue(id: $issueId) { comments(first: 100, after: $after) { nodes { body } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

notes: Paginate with ?after=cursor in variables; stop when response.data.issue.comments.pageInfo.hasNextPage is false
Requires issue.id from webhook payload to fetch comments
